name: Nike SB Air Force 1 Low 'Flax'
story_html: The Nike SB Air Force 1 Low 'Flax' delivers a monochrome colorway of an updated model built for skate. Wheat-colored suede is utilized on the upper, featuring tonal leather detailing on the heel tab. The latter is marked with Nike SB Air branding, matching the woven tag that adorns the padded tongue. This SB edition features a lower-profile midsole with Air-Sole cushioning in the heel. Underfoot, the gum rubber outsole retains the pivot circle traction pattern of the original.
